name: [SC] Player Stats Tracking
description:
Purpose: This law tracks stats for citizens (how many trees felled, blocks mined, animals hunted and plants gathered)
Type: [SC] Server Concept
Author: Daniel93a
Maintainer: Elmeye

Type /tax card in chat to see live suspended taxes relating to all tracking within this law.
Type /tax othercard white tiger in chat to see live suspended taxes relating to all global tracking.
